entities.name: Archaeal uS14A
observations: The 56-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt Q3IMX4, archaeal small ribosomal subunit protein uS14A from Natronomonas pharaonis (sequence homology tool result).
Reference annotation states it binds 16S rRNA and is required for assembly of 30S particles.
Reference GO annotations: structural constituent of ribosome, rRNA binding, zinc ion binding, cytoplasmic translation; evidence code ECO:0000501.
Reference cellular component annotation: cytosolic small ribosomal subunit; evidence code ECO:0000501.

entities.name: Cytoplasmic translation
observations: UniProt reference annotation assigns archaeal uS14A to cytoplasmic translation (GO:0002181; evidence code ECO:0000501).

entities.name: Cytosolic small ribosomal subunit
observations: UniProt reference annotation places archaeal uS14A in the cytosolic small ribosomal subunit (GO:0022627; evidence code ECO:0000501).
